title: 上海高考翻译背诵-85-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 任何欺骗消费者购买虚假产品的企业都将受到严惩。
items.en: Any enterprise that deceives consumers into purchasing fake products will be severely punished.

items.zh: 为尽可能降低风险,接触快递物品后应马上用肥皂洗手。
items.en: To minimize the risk, you should wash your hands with soap immediately after being exposed to delivery packages.

items.zh: 无论何时犯了错,没有必要为之辩解,要做的只是承认并立刻纠正它。
items.en: Whenever you make a mistake, there is no need to argue about it, and instead, just admit it and correct it immediately.

items.zh: 正因为同类性质的暴力事件在该国一再发生,总统发表声明表达愤怒和悲痛,并下令彻查。
items.en: It is because violent incidents of a similar nature keep happening in the country that the President has issued a statement to express his anger and grief, ordering a thorough investigation.
